nodes.name: On workflow error
nodes.notes: Fires whenever a workflow that selects this one as its Error Workflow fails. Without this, a failed run dies quietly and nobody finds out.

nodes.name: Alert by email
nodes.notes: Select your own SMTP credential and addresses, or swap this node for Slack/Telegram/whatever your team reads. The point is that failures reach a person.

meta.note: Import this workflow, point 'Alert by email' at your SMTP credential, then open the main demo workflow's Settings and select this one as its Error Workflow. A retry that exhausts its 3 attempts, or a validation throw, will then alert you instead of failing silently.
